episodes.synopsis: Toppa Bashin, who received a pendent with a red stone from his missing father, goes to meet the Battle Spirits champion J Sawaragi for a match.
episodes.title: Front Breaking Bashin Enters Stage!

episodes.synopsis: After his match against J, Bashin learns that he's a chosen card battler.
episodes.title: The Rival's Name is J

episodes.synopsis: It's Parents Day at Toaru Elementary school, and one of the rumored Nazo-Otona appears.
episodes.title: Parents Day in the Stormy Course of Life

episodes.synopsis: Popular idol My Sunshine disappears before a concert, and while searching for her, Bashin finds her alter-ego Suiren instead.
episodes.title: The Idol is My Sunshine

episodes.synopsis: Bashin and J's elementary schools face off at the athletics meet.
episodes.title: The Athletics Meet is Trouble

episodes.synopsis: Striker feels useless while in the hospital, so he decides to learn Battle Spirits.
episodes.title: Card Battler Hospital Visit

episodes.synopsis: Bashin and Striker are locked out of a My Sunshine performance.
episodes.title: Shut up the Uproar

episodes.synopsis: Bashin's class is going to Kyoto on a trip, but Meganeko is left behind.
episodes.title: Break Through From the Front at the Field Trip

episodes.synopsis: J locks in the guests at a party in his Kyoto home to catch a Nazo-Otona.
episodes.title: Okyou's Labyrinth?

episodes.synopsis: In order to mend his relationship with his mother, J decides to give up Battle Spirits.
episodes.title: Big Maze is Big Trouble

episodes.synopsis: My Sunshine announces on Battle Spirits TV that she doesn't like Battle Spirits.
episodes.title: The Great Batosupi Operation

episodes.synopsis: Bashin gives Siegfried to Striker, and goes off to try and win 100 battles without it.
episodes.title: Unidentified Unknown Invitation

episodes.synopsis: It's the day of the tournament, but Bashin is still in his room, sleeping.
episodes.title: Arrival of the Gunslinger's Apparition

episodes.synopsis: In the main tournament, Bashin and J make it to the final round.
episodes.title: First Final is Smile After Tears

episodes.synopsis: Bashin is planning a surprise for his school Christmas party.
episodes.title: A Faulted Perfect Christmas

episodes.synopsis: After getting in a fight with Bashin over his deck, Aibou runs off.
episodes.title: The Day Aibou Disappeared

episodes.synopsis: Suiren's true identity is revealed to be... an old lady?
episodes.title: My First Sunshine

episodes.synopsis: While Meganeko plays detective, J invites Bashin and his friends to test a new battle system.
episodes.title: Break Through From the Front in Winter

episodes.synopsis: Elliott plans to open a Battle Spirits school in America.
episodes.title: Thrilling Tag Rivals

episodes.synopsis: On the last day of school, Bashin decides to ditch the surprise party his class planned for Card Sensei.
episodes.title: A Broken Friendship is a Constant Disagreement

episodes.synopsis: Noticing how off Bashin, who still hasn't apologized to Meganeko has been, Striker decides he needs Valentines chocolate to feel better.
episodes.title: My Sunshine Valentine

episodes.synopsis: Meganeko starts her training under Card Sensei, where she chooses to be a yellow card battler.
episodes.title: Being a Nazo Otona was His Secret

episodes.synopsis: Bashin wants to test his new X-Rare on J, but he's still acting strangely.
episodes.title: Last Days as an Elementary Schooler

episodes.synopsis: Meganeko enters the spring tournament, disguised as the masked card battler Kiiroko.
episodes.title: Spring Batosupi- A Yellow Storm

episodes.synopsis: If he can defeat Kiiroko, Bashin will get to face J again in the finals.
episodes.title: A Flash of Light- The Cornerstone's Awakening

episodes.synopsis: J throws a graduation party, and Bashin brings Kiiroko along to surprise his friends.
episodes.title: Batosupi Under the Sakura

episodes.synopsis: My Sunshine is going through artists block, so her manager hires a music critic for her.
episodes.title: Pink and Amade Us

episodes.synopsis: Battle Spirits TV films a special at J's castle, which is rumored to be haunted.
episodes.title: J- Trip to a Town of Romance

episodes.synopsis: Bashin and the others finally enter middle school, where both he and J find Numbers within their new schools.
episodes.title: Middle School Uniforms New School Uniforms

episodes.synopsis: Bashin wants to join the Battle Spirits club, which may not even exist.
episodes.title: Thriving Spirits Batosupi Club

episodes.synopsis: My Sunshine learns that her new school lacks a Battle Spirits club, and tries to rectify that.
episodes.title: A Student Council for Batosupi

episodes.synopsis: Hayami wonders if she needs to let go of Bashin, when he'd rather spend time with his friends than her.
episodes.title: A Letter From the Speed Star

episodes.synopsis: The Battle Spirits club finds that they need an advisor to go on a trip for Golden Week.
episodes.title: Aim for the Weak Point for the Advisor Too!

episodes.synopsis: At training camp, Striker becomes concerned at the lack of teamwork from his fellow club members.
episodes.title: The Treacherous Training Camp Jack

episodes.synopsis: J's father is opposed to his son joining Numbers Elite, but doesn't know how to confront him about it.
episodes.title: Break Through From the Front of Tests and Fathers

episodes.synopsis: The Toaru and Tonari Battle Spirits clubs combine, to face Numbers Elite in Kyoto.
episodes.title: Hot Blooded Batosupi Club at the Capital

episodes.synopsis: While their owners are stuck taking tests, the pets decide to confront Okyou.
episodes.title: The Spirit of Aibou's Group

episodes.synopsis: When My Sunshine is frustrated over her movie, Meganeko comes to her for help.
episodes.title: Rapid Loop Pool

episodes.synopsis: Bashin forms a team to get back J, but before the tournament, Seven defects.
episodes.title: Deep Close Contact with the Opposing Team- The Curtain Raised?

episodes.synopsis: Suspicious of Masako's true identity, Striker confronts Elliott.
episodes.title: Break Through- The Space Between Family and Team

episodes.synopsis: Bashin is set to face Jack Knight in the final round, but the order was suddenly changed.
episodes.title: Confrontation! Black Knight and Queen will Definitely be Finished

episodes.synopsis: At last Bashin and Jack Knight battle, but King Uchuuchouten brings real spirits into the match.
episodes.title: Settlement- In Jack's Night, Death is Rebirth

episodes.synopsis: Number Nine entrusts Number Eight the task of delivering invitations to the King Uchuuchouten Cup, as a test of loyalty.
episodes.title: The Revived Master is a Blue Comet

episodes.synopsis: While on a trip to the beach, Striker notices My Sunshine is acting strangely, so the pets convince him she must be in love with someone.
episodes.title: Surfing, Sun and Striker

episodes.synopsis: Meganeko finds a photo of her grandfather with King Uchuuchouten, along with a new X-Rare.
episodes.title: Break Through From the Front in Summer

episodes.synopsis: Realizing Number Nine's true intentions, Elliott and Kiano decide to try and stop him.
episodes.title: The Cornerstone Six- Disappearance the Day Before the Finals

episodes.synopsis: Before the King Uchuuchouten Cup begins, Card Sensei and the others look for the disappeared Masako Sensei.
episodes.title: Break Through From the Front Showtime- The Curtain Raised!

episodes.synopsis: Striker and Suiren have one last secret weapon that could help defeat Number Nine.
episodes.title: The Last Opponent Nine- The Last Battle

episodes.synopsis: Bashin and J reveal their new X-Rare to defeat Seven and Smile.
episodes.title: Take it From the Life! Shine, Cornerstone's Settlement!!

episodes.synopsis: Both the real world and Isekai World are at risk in Bashin's battle with King Uchuuchouten.
episodes.title: Miracle Card Battler- Bashin Breaks Through From the Front!
